assessment: This paper reports a fundamental study explaining how signalling through a cell-surface receptor can lead to different cellular outputs through changing interactions with membrane lipids. The evidence supporting the conclusions is compelling, with state-of-the-art microscopy, including multicolour super-resolution microscopy and single-molecule imaging, coupled with carefully controlled experiments. This work will be of broad interest to cell biologists, particularly those with interests in cell signalling and lipid biology, in addition to researchers using imaging to study cellular phenomena.
